description: 后兵对后 — 白方王的挺进，穿越连将护送c兵升变

intro.popup_en: The white c-pawn is one step from promotion, but Black's queen on c8 blocks it. White plans to advance the king, use the queen to cut off the checks, promote the pawn, and mate with two queens.
intro.popup:
⚔️ 后兵对后
白兵c7只差一步升变！黑后守在c8封锁通路。
白方计划：王向前挺进，后伺机截断黑后连将，兵升变后双后绝杀！

outro.popup_en: White wins. The king's advance forces the black queen to keep changing squares; Qb5 cuts off the checks, allowing the c-pawn to promote. The two queens then deliver mate together.
outro.popup: ✅ 白方获胜！王的挺进迫使黑后不断换位，白后在b5关键截断，c兵成功升变。双后联手完成绝杀。

moves.popup_en: The white queen takes c5, controlling the promotion route while the king prepares to advance.
moves.popup: 白后占c5，控制升变通路，王准备前进。

moves.popup_en: The black queen starts a series of checks, trying to stop the white king's advance.
moves.popup: ⚡ 黑后连将开始，企图阻止白王推进！

moves.popup_en: The white king reaches the seventh rank. The checks cannot stop its advance.
moves.popup: 白王直抵第7行！连将阻止不了王的推进。

moves.popup_en: The key cutoff: the white queen reaches b5 and blocks the black queen's checking route, clearing the way for the c-pawn to promote.
moves.popup: ⭐ 关键截断！白后移至b5，封堵黑后连将路线——c7兵升变之路打开！

moves.popup_en: The pawn promotes on c8. White now has two queens.
moves.popup: 🎉 升变！c7兵晋升为后，白方双后登场！

moves.popup_en: Checkmate with two queens. The black king is trapped in the corner with no escape.
moves.popup: ♛♛ 双后绝杀！黑王困于角落，无路可逃。
